style: STYLE: traditional Chinese shadow puppet (piying) demons exactly in the style of the reference image: dyed translucent leather in cinnabar red, jade green, bronze-gold, black lacquer and deep brown, intricate hollowed-out lace carving cut clean through the leather (cloud, flame, fret and scale patterns), crisp flat silhouettes with fine dark carved outlines, warm backlit glow, small antique-bronze rivets. Flat 2D, no perspective, no cast shadows, menacing folklore monsters.

sheet.prompt:
Use case: four monster sprites for a side-scrolling shadow-puppet game. The attached image is ONLY a style reference (leather, lace carving, palette) - do not copy its characters.
Layout is critical: landscape 3:2 image, exactly two rows by two columns, one monster centred in each quarter, generous empty gutters, monsters never touch each other or the edges, no labels, no text, no ground, no extra objects. Background: fully transparent if possible, otherwise perfectly flat pure white #FFFFFF; the carved lace holes must show the background through them. Do not paint white or near-white colour on the puppets; the lightest colour is warm amber.
Every monster: strict side profile facing RIGHT, whole body visible, standing on all its feet on one flat horizontal baseline at the bottom of its quarter, one single rigid flat leather piece (no separate floating parts), menacing, about the same height as each other except the guardian which is bulkier.
TOP LEFT: Shanxiao, a hunched one-legged-style mountain ape demon with shaggy carved fur, long arms with claws, a fanged grimacing mask face, red loincloth, standing on two short legs.
TOP RIGHT: a fire fox demon, long low body on four legs, three huge flame-shaped carved tails curling up and back, flame lace patterns, red and gold.
BOTTOM LEFT: the mountain guardian beast (zhenshanshou), a massive stone-lion-like temple guardian on four thick legs, curly carved mane, armour plates with rivets, red ribbon sash, bulkier than the others.
BOTTOM RIGHT: a vine spirit, a gaunt walking tangle of twisted roots and vines forming a humanoid on two legs with long clawed root fingers, a pale bone mask face, green leaves sprouting from its head.
